svg.title: The editor on the pedal: what each switch does
svg.text: The editor on the pedal: what each switch does
Bank Down and Bank Up held for two seconds open it, and again close it. What you change is written as the cursor leaves it.
On the setlist screen, A and B move the song one place, C puts in the bank the pedal is on, and 3 below bank 1 takes the song out.
